messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gateway-service returning elevated 5xx rate (30m avg: 6.8%, threshold 1.0%). Alert triggered for route: /v1/generate, region: us-east-1 :rotating_light:

sanjay: getting paged, looking now. any known deploys in last 30m?

elaine: not from infra, but runtime team rolled a small kernel selection tweak ~40m ago. tagging @maya and @devon for scope.

maya: I see a spike in 502s in the gateway logs but timestamps are sparse. trying to pull full logs — our ELK index for gateway-ingress shows large gaps (shard reads failing). :confused:

devon: oncall handoff: i'm on until 18:00. if you want me to take lead after quick context, say so.

sanjay: @devon pls take lead for triage, i'll coordinate customer comms.

devon: taking lead. quick summary: 5xx are mostly 502/504 from gateway to runtime. error_rate peaked ~12% for 2 min at 16:12. impact: all hosted customers in us-east-1, some Dedicated routes (no Private deployments reported).

maya: trying to map request ids -> traces, but trace service (x-trace-proxy) shows no spans for gateway->runtime hops. our propagated trace-id header appears missing on many requests.

elaine: that's the observability gap we feared. the gateway was recently overlayed with the new fast-path config that doesn't copy x-trace-id into the upstream call unless sampling enabled.

devon: ok this is actionable. mitigation plan: 1) re-enable trace header propagation on gateway (hot config) 2) temporarily increase trace sampling to 100% for 10m to rebuild context 3) add emergency logs to runtime to capture upstream request-id and backend error detail 4) if still high, revert fast-path change.

sanjay: customer impact note: pager shows 23 customers with >1 failed request in last 15m; top three accounts: acct-131, acct-44, acct-990 (high-volume). I'll open a customer-impact doc after we stabilize.

devon: executing step 1 now — applying hotpatch to gateway config to force header copy. command: ```kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway GATEWAY_FORCE_PROPAGATE=true --record```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/gateway in namespace gateway by devon (rev: patch/propagate-headers).

maya: step 2: bumping tracing sampler via API. patch: ```curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/v1/config/tracing" -d '{"sampler_rate":1.0,"duration_secs":600}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'```

devon: patched. tracer sampling now 100% for 10m. logs should start filling in ~30s after propagation.

elaine: note — metrics backend (prometheus remote write) was dropping a small percentage of metrics due to backlog. that explains why our alerting is underestimating earlier. pushing a fix to increase retention window.

maya: I'm still seeing a lot of 502s but new logs have more info: runtime backend returns `UpstreamError: connection reset by peer` at the start of the tokenization kernel. stacktrace snippet: ```runtime/kernel/kvcache.go:142: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed```

devon: could be runtime worker OOMs or TCP RSTs. can we check node health? I'll jump into infra console.

sanjay: reporting to CS: we will acknowledge and say we're investigating; possible degraded performance for generation requests in US-EAST. ETA: 30-60m.

maya: observability gap — spans are coming back but older requests still have no trace id. we won't be able to reconstruct everything. proposing stopgap: 1) enable request-id log injection at gateway (adds req_id to every log line) 2) start streaming raw gateway logs to S3 for the next hour for forensic analysis 3) add a short-lived metric `gateway.upstream_connection_resets` via a push to prometheus pushgateway from gateway process.

elaine: agree. please add the pushgateway metric so we can graph resets in 1min resolution. maya, can you paste the snippet you'll deploy?

maya: deploying small go wrapper to emit metric: ```/bin/gateway-metrics-pusher --endpoint=http://pushgateway.internal:9091 --job=gateway-hot --grouping=region=us-east --metric=name:gateway_upstream_connection_resets,type:counter```

devon: infra console shows a subset of runtime pods cycling with `OOMKilled` over the last 12m on nodes n-us-e-3b and n-us-e-6c. looks correlated. scaling runtime pool up + draining problematic nodes now.

sanjay: scaling ramp should reduce direct 5xx from backend while we fix OOM root cause. also adding orchestration note to avoid extra restarts: `kubectl scale deployment/runtime --replicas=24`.

incident-bot: scale-bot: scaled deployment/runtime to 24 replicas in namespace runtime by devon.

maya: logs show that tokenization used a lot more memory for certain inputs (edge-case prompt length). runtime team: please add a guard to reject requests exceeding X tokens instead of letting OOM occur.

devon: will add a config guard. short-term: adding ulimit and workspace memory caps on runtime container to avoid node-level OOM cascades.

elaine: we've got increased metrics now: `gateway_upstream_connection_resets` spiked at 16:14 to ~870 and is trending down after scale. 5xx rate has dropped to 1.7% 5m avg. still above SLO but improving.

sanjay: good. customer comms update: posted brief incident note to status.redwood.ai (investigating elevated 5xx in us-east; mitigation in progress).

devon: next steps: 1) keep sampling at 100% for another 10m to ensure traces captured 2) rotate nodes out with kernel selection tweak revert on problematic nodes 3) create postmortem ticket once stable 4) backlog instrument req_id propagation tests into CI.

maya: postmortem blockers: we still lack historical spans for window 15:50-16:05. forensics require logs from ELK — shard reads failing earlier. stopgap we did (S3 dump) should let us reconstruct.

elaine: I'll open infra ticket to increase ELK indexing retries and to add alert when trace count drops >30% vs request count.

devon: 5xx rate now 0.9% 5m avg. lowering severity to SEV-3. i'll watch for 15m. handing back to @sanjay for customer updates and to create the postmortem skeleton.

sanjay: thanks team. i'll own the postmortem and customer follow-ups. logging the incident now: Incident-1773204567. can everyone drop any outstanding notes in the doc?

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 18:00. devon will be primary until then.

maya: quick note for PMs — tokens with long prompt prefix triggered kernel path leading to memory blowout. needs model-input validation and better quantization profile.

elaine: adding follow-up actions to backlog: observability coverage audit, CI test for header propagation, and ELK shard resiliency.

sanjay: closing thread for active fixes; will reopen if 5xx >1.5% again. :white_check_mark:
